data.name: Magi Tower
data.detailed_description:
Magi Tower is a co-op MMO raid-inspired roguelike where teamwork, positioning, and mastering mechanics is how you will succeed. Gather your party and conquer the Tower solo or with up to 4 players online or through LAN or Online. Face challenging raid bosses with unique mechanics and attack patterns that demand quick reactions, good planing and the perfect build.

Create your own cute character, choose a class, and prepare for intense battles. Build your character each run with over 100 random items — become an unstoppable DPS powerhouse, support your allies with powerful buffs. Work together, avoid devastating wipes, and climb the Tower.

Features

  • 1–4 player co-op online or LAN

  • Challenging raid-style boss fights with unique mechanics

  • Over 100 random items for endless build variety

  • Unlockables and achievements to showcase your mastery

  • Full controller and mouse & keyboard support

data.short_description: Face intense MMO-inspired raid battles without the grind. Fight through challanging boss encounters in solo or in 1–4 player co-op, learning intricate attack patterns while shaping your build with randomized upgrades each run. Gather your party, choose your class, and climb the Magi Tower.
